Key for Schools

                                             Contents

   Test 1
   Part 1 Food and Clothes

Test 1

Part 1 (3-4 minutes)
Phase 1
Interlocutor

To both candidates    Good morning / afternoon / evening.
                      Can I have your mark sheets, please?

                      Hand over the mark sheets to the Assessor.

                      I’m …………, and this is …….… .

To Candidate A        What’s your name?

To Candidate B        And what’s your name?

Interlocutor          B, how old are you?      Back-up prompts
                      Where do you come from?
For UK, ask           Where do you live?       Are you from (Spain, etc.)?
For Non-UK, ask       Thank you.               Do you live in … (name of district / town etc.)?

For UK, ask           A, how old are you?      Are you from (Spain, etc.)?
For Non-UK, ask       Where do you come from?  Do you live in … (name of district / town etc.)?
                      Where do you live?
                      Thank you.

Phase 2                                    Back-up prompts
Interlocutor                               Did you have pizza yesterday?
Now, let’s talk about food.                Do you have breakfast at 7 o’clock?
                                           Do you have a snack after school?
A, what did you have for lunch yesterday?  Do you cook dinner?
What time do you usually have breakfast?   Back-up questions
B, what do you usually eat after school?   Do you eat sweets with friends?
Who cooks your meals at home?              Did you eat with your friends last weekend?
Extended Response                          Do you and your friends go to restaurants?
Now, A, please tell me something about
what you like to eat with friends.         Back-up prompts
                                           Do you wear a uniform to school?
Now, let’s talk about clothes.             Do you like white clothes?
                                           Do you wear your favourite clothes?
B, what clothes do you wear to school?
What’s your favourite colour for clothes?  Do you buy your clothes with your friends?
A, what clothes do you wear when you go    Back-up questions
to a party?                                Do you like to buy T-shirts?
Who helps you to buy your clothes?         Have you bought any clothes this month?
Extended Response                          (What?)
Now, B, please tell me something about     Do you buy clothes in a shopping centre?
the clothes you like to buy.

Test 1

Part 2 (5-6 minutes)

Phase 1               Now, in this part of the test you are going to talk together.
Interlocutor
                      Place Candidate booklet, open at Task 1, in front of candidates.
 3-4 minutes
                      Here are some pictures that show different outdoor activities.
Candidates
                      Do you like these different outdoor activities? Say why or why not. I’ll say
Interlocutor          that again.

Use as appropriate.   Do you like these different outdoor activities? Say why or why not.
Ask each candidate
at least one          All right? Now, talk together.
question.
                      ………………………………………………………..
                       Allow a minimum of 1 minute (maximum of 2 minutes) before moving on

                      to the following questions.

                      Do you think …                      Optional prompt
                      … skateboarding is difficult?       Why?/Why not?
                      … swimming in a lake is dangerous?
                      … going for a bike ride is fun?     What do you think?
                      … having a picnic is boring?
                      … going to a concert is expensive?

                      So, A, which of these outdoor activities do you like best?

                      And you, B, which of these outdoor activities do you like best?

                      Thank you. (Can I have the booklet, please?) Retrieve Candidate booklet.

Phase 2               Now, do you prefer being by the sea or in the mountains, B? (Why?)
                      And what about you, A? (Do you prefer being by the sea or in the
Interlocutor          mountains?) (Why?)

 Allow up to 2       Is it better to do sports alone or with other people, A? (Why?)
minutes               And you, B? (Is it better to do sports alone or with other people?) (Why?)
                      Thank you. That is the end of the test.
Do you like these different outdoor activities?
